hints.title: Concatenated String Doubling
hints.text: Any rotation of a string s of length n appears as an n-length contiguous substring within s concatenated with itself.

hints.title: Length and Substring Equivalence Invariant
hints.text: A string s can shift to goal if and only if both strings share identical length and goal is a substring of s + s.

hints.title: Direct Inclusion Verification Procedure
hints.text: Check if len(s) equals len(goal). If false, return false. Concatenate s with itself to form double string s + s. Return true if goal is contained within s + s, else return false.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: input length or search state bound
complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all n rotations individually and comparing requires O(N^2) work.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Checking membership in s + s runs in O(N) linear time using O(N) auxiliary string space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize the double-string concatenation idiom for circular string rotation checks.
